item.title: reports: per-account-and-currency totals
item.brief: In the reports Python tool (stdin CSV -> stdout), total amounts per (account, currency). Accept the new header `date,account,amount_cents,currency` and the old header without `currency` (old rows count as USD). Output header `account,currency,total_cents`, one row per pair, sorted by account then currency. A malformed currency code (not exactly three uppercase ASCII letters) prints an error to stderr and exits with status 2. Keep `python3 -m unittest` passing and add tests for: old CSV still works as USD, new CSV totals per currency, sorting, malformed code exits 2. Update the README to describe the new input and output. Commit the change in this repository with the author set by the repository's existing git config; no attribution lines.

pr.body: Approach: reports.py parses the header (exact match to old or new field list), defaults currency to USD for the old header, validates each currency with fullmatch [A-Z]{3}, and keys totals by (account, currency). Malformed code raises MalformedCurrency, caught in main(), printed to stderr with line number, exit 2. item.title: ledger: currency column and validation
item.brief: In the ledger Rust tool (stdin TSV -> stdout CSV), accept an optional fourth TSV column with an ISO 4217 code (exactly three uppercase ASCII letters). Default to USD when absent. Emit header `date,account,amount_cents,currency` and a currency value on every row. A malformed code prints an error naming the line number to stderr and exits with status 2; other input errors keep exiting 1. Keep `cargo test` passing, add tests for: missing currency defaults to USD, explicit currency, malformed code (lowercase, wrong length, digits) exits 2 with line number, other errors still exit 1. Update the README to describe the new input and output format. Commit the change in this repository with the author set by the repository's existing git config; no attribution lines.

pr.body: Approach: parse_line returns a typed ParseError (Invalid -> exit 1, BadCurrency -> exit 2). Currency validated as exactly 3 uppercase ASCII bytes after trimming. Key files: src/lib.rs, src/main.rs, tests/ledger.rs (unit + binary-level tests), README.md. Checks: cargo test 9/9 pass; clippy clean; rustfmt clean on touched test code (pre-existing unformatted lines in src/lib.rs left untouched). Assumptions: an empty fourth column (trailing tab) is malformed (exit 2), not missing; a line with a bad currency and another error exits with the other error's status (1); currency is shape-checked only; Cargo version not bumped. Open follow-ups: consider a version bump for the output header change; decide whether error precedence and empty-column handling should change.
pr.summary: ledger now reads an optional currency column (ISO 4217 shape, default USD) and emits it per row. before: 3-column CSV, now: 4-column CSV with currency; malformed currency exits 2, other errors exit 1.

agt_01M88PYPDFPB9SB0AWZP8FXCM2:1.description: README says the currency 'must be an ISO 4217 code', but the code only checks shape (three uppercase ASCII letters). 'ABC' is accepted. at README.md:17

agt_01M88PYPDFPB9SB0AWZP8FXCM2:2.description: Error precedence: a line with a malformed currency and another error (bad date, bad account, bad amount, or wrong field count) exits 1, not 2. Only lines whose other fields parse exit 2. at src/lib.rs:51

agt_01M88PYPDFPB9SB0AWZP8FXCM2:3.description: parse_currency trims the field first (called with code.trim()), so ' EUR ' is accepted. The spec says exactly three uppercase letters, and the other fields are trimmed too, so this is consistent but looser than the stated rule. at src/lib.rs:64

agt_01M88PYPDFPB9SB0AWZP8FXCM2:4.description: An empty fourth column (trailing tab, e.g. '...\t1\t') is treated as a malformed currency (exit 2), not as a missing currency that defaults to USD. The unit test pins this ('' is rejected). at src/lib.rs:51

agt_01M88PYPDFPB9SB0AWZP8FXCM2:5.description: The output format changed (new header and extra column, which breaks downstream readers), but the crate version stays at 0.3.0. at Cargo.toml:3

risk.why: CLI stdout header and row shape change for every consumer, and a new exit status 2. Behaviour change in src/lib.rs, src/main.rs; tests and docs updated. Reviewers confirmed high.
